chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Al-Numan, from Abu Hafs Al-A'sha, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:

I heard him (peace be upon him) saying: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: 'The one who strives to fulfill a need of his brother but does not advise him, has betrayed Allah and His Messenger.'
ai.seo_question: What is the difference between helping a brother and betraying him according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In Shia scholarship, this hadith from Al-Kafi underscores that 'sincerity' (nasaha) in assisting a brother is not merely transactional but requires holistic guidance, reflecting the Prophetic model of care. The severe warning that failure to advise constitutes betrayal of God and the Prophet elevates this ethical duty to a spiritual imperative, linking interpersonal conduct directly to divine accountability.
